data.name: Damir
data.gender_notes: Damir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who supports and follows. The name Damir carries the meaning “Follower, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Damir usually hope their child will grow to embody follower, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the security and protection provided by Allah and the love and care of one's family.
data.etymology: Damir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Damir total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ضمير
in_arabic.meaning: الضمير يعني القلب أو العقل أو النفس في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الضمير في اللغة العربية مشتق من الجذر 'ض-م-ر' والذي يعني القلب أو العقل. اسم الضمير في الثقافة الإسلامية يحمل معاني عميقة تتعلق بالنفس والروح. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، الضمير يرمز إلى الوعي الذاتي والمسؤولية الأخلاقية للإنسان.

in_urdu.name: ضمیر
in_urdu.meaning: ضمیر کا مطلب ہے دل، دماغ یا خود
in_urdu.long_meaning: ضمیر عربی زبان کے جذر 'ض-م-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے دل یا دماغ۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، ضمیر گہری روحانی اور نفسیاتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن میں مذکور ہے اور اس کا تعلق انسان کی خودی اور اخلاقی ذمہ داری سے ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، ضمیر نام روایتی اور معاصر دونوں طرح اہم ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ضمیر
in_hindi.meaning: दमीर का अर्थ है दिल, दिमाग या आत्मा
in_hindi.long_meaning: दमीर नाम की उत्पत्ति 'ض-م-ر' जड़ से हुई है जिसका अर्थ है दिल या दिमाग। इस्लामी परंपरा में, दमीर गहरे आध्यात्मिक और मानसिक महत्व का वाहक है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक और आधुनिक दोनों संदर्भों में प्रासंगिक है, आत्मा और नैतिक जिम्मेदारी की धारणाओं से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: ضمير
in_pashto.meaning: ضمير دى چه معنا لري د زړه، ذهن يا نفس
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کلتور کې، ضمير د 'ض-م-ر' ريښې څخه اخستل شوی دی چې د زړه يا ذهن معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړلی دی، چې د نفس، روحانيت او اخلاقي مسؤلیت په معنا ټینګار کوي.

in_english.name: Damir
in_english.meaning: Damir means heart, mind, or conscience in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Damir originates from the Arabic root 'ض-م-ر' (ḍ-m-r), which relates to the heart or mind. In Islamic tradition, Damir carries profound spiritual and psychological significance, symbolizing self-awareness, moral responsibility, and inner consciousness. The name is mentioned in the Quran and reflects the Islamic emphasis on the inner life and ethical conduct. Across Muslim cultures, Damir remains a meaningful name, conveying attributes of introspection and righteousness.

It is a name that connotes strength, resilience, and steadfastness in the face of challenges. The cultural significance of this name can be seen in its usage among strong, independent individuals, particularly in the Middle East and other Muslim communities, as a source of inspiration and motivation to weather the storms of life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Damir can be understood as signifying one who steadfastly follows the path of Allah. The name is derived from the Arabic root "damara," meaning "to follow" or "to support," and signifies one who is steadfast in faith and obedient to the will of Allah. Thus, for individuals with this name, it serves as a constant reminder of their spiritual obligations and the importance of staying on the right path, even during times of hardship and temptation. The name Damir can be recognized as a source of strength, sustenance, and guidance in the journey of life, guiding individuals towards Allah and the true meaning of success and prosperity.
